description: This Java class, LogWrapper, implements the LogNode interface and wraps Android's native Log utility. Its purpose is to facilitate logging by forwarding log messages and exceptions to the Android log system and optionally passing them to the next LogNode in a chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate flexible logging and chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs the log message to Android's log system, optionally including a Throwable, and passes the message to the next node.
